definition.name: Shift Site to Match Property Line Coordinates
definition.description: Shifts the active site's E/W and N/S (keeping angle and elevation) so a property line's corners read given shared E/N coordinates.
definition.aiDescription: Shifts the active site's E/W and N/S (keeping angle and elevation) so a property line's corners read given shared E/N coordinates.
examples: make the plot limit corners read these coordinates
reassign shared coordinates to match the property line
